name: OSINT MCP Server
description: A comprehensive MCP server providing tools for IP, domain, email, and image-based open-source intelligence. It integrates services like Shodan, VirusTotal, and HaveIBeenPwned to facilitate advanced security research and data gathering.

rawRecord.description: A comprehensive MCP server providing tools for IP, domain, email, and image-based open-source intelligence. It integrates services like Shodan, VirusTotal, and HaveIBeenPwned to facilitate advanced security research and data gathering.

HOST.description: The host the server will bind to (default is 0.0.0.0).

PORT.description: The port the server will listen on (default is 3000).

EXA_API_KEY.description: API key for Exa Web Search.

HIBP_API_KEY.description: API key for HaveIBeenPwned (used for breach checking).

HUNTER_API_KEY.description: API key for Hunter.io (used for domain email searches).

IMAGGA_API_KEY.description: API key for Imagga image tagging.

SHODAN_API_KEY.description: API key for Shodan (used for host details and WHOIS lookup).

ZOOMEYE_API_KEY.description: API key for ZoomEye (used for host searches).

SAUCENAO_API_KEY.description: API key for SauceNAO (used for reverse image search).

GREYNOISE_API_KEY.description: API key for GreyNoise (used for IP context).

IMAGGA_API_SECRET.description: API secret for Imagga image tagging.

ALIENVAULT_API_KEY.description: API key for AlienVault OTX (used for threat intel).

VIRUSTOTAL_API_KEY.description: API key for VirusTotal (used for URL reputation).

GOOGLE_CLOUD_API_KEY.description: API key for Google Cloud Vision analysis.

SECURITYTRAILS_API_KEY.description: API key for SecurityTrails (used for subdomain discovery).

rawRecord.name: OSINT MCP Server
